description: This file defines the IBM DB2 Native Client driver for the ADOdb database abstraction library in PHP. It includes classes for establishing connections, executing queries, managing transactions, and retrieving metadata specific to the DB2 database system.

classes.name: ADODB_db2
classes.description: Main class implementing the database driver for IBM DB2, managing connection, executing queries, schema inspection, and metadata functions.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_db2
classes.description: Class representing a recordset fetched from a DB2 database query, providing methods for fetching data and metadata.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a DB2 connection using provided DSN, username, password, and database name.

methods.name: prepareSp
methods.description: Prepares a stored procedure call, validating the procedure name and retrieving parameter info.

methods.name: executeStoredProcedure
methods.description: Executes a prepared stored procedure using bound parameters.

methods.name: metaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns of a specified table, including types, lengths, and primary key info.
